simple.meaning: קָשַׁשׁ (qâshash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to forage for straw , stubble or wood ; figuratively, to assemble.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 8 times in Exodus, Numbers, 1 Kings, Zephaniah, beginning at Exodus 5:7. The surrounding contexts include family line, city, land, wilderness, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָשַׁשׁ (H7197) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קָשַׁשׁ (qâshash) / H7197 is traced through Exodus 5:7, Exodus 5:12, Numbers 15:32, Numbers 15:33 with source-language evidence and verse context.

timeline.evidenceText: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her, and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have a cake, but a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

[ קָשַׁשׁ ] doubtful verb , only Qal Imperative + Hithpo`el Imperative , וָקוֺשּׁוּ הִתְקוֺשְׁשׁוּ Zeph 2:1 ; AV RV gather yourselves together, yea gather together , from foregoing (compare Vrss), but this only denominative in specific meaning gather stubble, sticks , etc.; read probably with Gr Bu SK 1893, 396 and others הִתְבּוֺשְׁשׁוּ .
